verdict.rationale: Authy is a 2FA authenticator app with a developer API, so issuing scoped, least-privilege credentials for an agent is a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence describes scoped API keys, permission scoping, or agent-specific credentials. The docs cover only SDKs, 2FA verification channels and device management, and the probe notes the Authy API is closed to new customers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
